description: Use when scheduling across time zones or turning a local time into UTC without guessing DST. Input: to (IANA zones or KST, PST, CET...), optional from (zone of a local time, default UTC), time (ISO 8601, Unix seconds, or now). Output: JSON UTC instant, Unix time, and per zone: local ISO time with offset, weekday, abbreviation, DST and business-hours flags, day difference. Example: ?time=2026-10-12T09:00&from=Asia/Seoul&to=America/New_York,Europe/London Price: $0.002 USDC via x402.

from.description: Zone of the input local time (default UTC; ignored when time has an offset)

to.description: 1–25 target zones, comma-separated (IANA names like Asia/Seoul, UTC, or abbreviations like KST, PST, CET)

name: time_convert
title: Time-zone conversion: one instant in many zones, DST-aware, offsets, business hours
